**Gold file:** `gold.json` (no `golden.json` in this case dir). I read `ranked.json` in full before opening the gold, and before running the scorer.

**Answer shape:** flat array of 75 paths — single-repo shape, which is what `gold.json` uses here, so no flattening was needed. `case_family` confirms `single-repo`. The list was not touched.

`score_arm.py` does not compute precision@10, precision@20, F1@20, or F1_full_list — the scorer emits only `precision@5` plus the recall ladder and MRR. Per the rules I did not hand-compute the missing four; recall@75 is the full-list recall since `retrieved` = `list_cap` = 75.

**Surface verdict: not comparable** — one reason. Tool calls, counted from `commands.log` (56 lines) and not from the run's own account: `collateral_damage` 24, `stakeout` 15, `the_receipts` 8, `blueprint` 3, `case_file` 2, `roll_call` 1, `rap_sheet` 1, `manhunt` 1, `ToolSearch` 1. Here the log and the self-report agree exactly. No filesystem or shell tool was called (`permission_denials` is empty, so nothing was attempted and blocked either), and `stakeout` — the retriever's search tool — fired 15 times, so neither of those two reasons applies. The disqualifying one is caching: `cache_read=9,648,062` and `cache_creation=234,330`, i.e. the run executed warm, so its $8.43 is not comparable with cold-cache runs in the series. `score_arm.py`'s own surface block reports `comparable: true` because it does not inspect token usage; I kept it verbatim under `surface_as_scored_by_score_arm` and put the log-derived block, with the reason, at `surface`.

**What the misses share:** both are in `apps/api/v2` — the versioned platform API layer (a dated controller and its input service), not the monorepo's `packages/features` core. Everything the run found sits in the workflow/booking feature packages or shared schema; the two it did not are the same mechanism re-expressed at the external API boundary, under a date-versioned directory register (`2024-04-15`, `2024-08-13`) that shares no naming vocabulary with the feature-side paths. The run did reach `apps/api/v2` twice — `workflows.repository.ts` at rank 38 and `workflows.output.service.ts` at 48 — so that app was not invisible to it; what stayed out of reach was the bookings-side v2 surface rather than the v2 tree as a whole.
